channels.name: VS Code Marketplace
channels.instructions: Upload the VSIX under publisher living-code-theme (display name Living Code), or run this port's manual publish-vscode workflow. Confirm publisher access and the migration from elliotluque.living-code first; the new extension ID does not automatically replace old installs.

channels.name: Open VSX
channels.instructions: Create/verify namespace living-code-theme and its token access. Publish the same VSIX with the port's manual workflow or ovsx publish <vsix>. No registry upload is performed by packaging.
